Preserved every identifier, state, API path, and i18n contract verbatim: state names showCreate/newName/newPerm/generatedKey/deleteTarget; the isExpired(k) = k.expiresAt && new Date(k.expiresAt) < new Date() predicate (wrapped in Boolean() + useCallback for stable identity, same truthiness); the APIKey field reads id/name/permissions/keyPrefix/createdAt/lastUsedAt/expiresAt; the mutation call shapes createMut.mutate({name,permissions},{onSuccess:data=>setGeneratedKey(data.key)}), revokeMut.mutate(k.id), deleteMut.mutate(deleteTarget.id,{onSuccess}); createMut.isPending -> loading; disabled=!newName.trim(); the read/read-write/admin permission values and #10b981/#f59e0b/#a855f7 colours. API paths are unchanged because the unmodified native useAdmin hooks (/api-keys, /api-keys/{id}, /api-keys/{id}/revoke) are reused. Every t('English string') key is kept verbatim — t('API Keys'),'Manage programmatic access to TeslaSync','Create Key','API Key Created','New API Key',"Copy this key now — it won't be shown again.",'API key, click to reveal','Copy API key','Done','Name','My Application','Permissions','Read','Read-Write','Admin','Generate Key','Cancel','No API keys','Create an API key to enable programmatic access to TeslaSync data and controls.','Created','Last used','Expired','Revoke','Delete','Delete API Key','Are you sure you want to permanently delete the key "{{name}}"?' — through a native key/English-default `t` fallback (react-i18next is not wired on native) that applies the same {{name}} interpolation as the web `t`.

PageContainer (title/subtitle/actions + a loading gate that renders the body only when loading is false) is reproduced as an inline scaffold: a persistent header (page title + subtitle + the primary 'Create Key' action) and a body that, exactly like web, swaps to a centered ActivityIndicator while isLoading and otherwise renders the children (create modal + list + confirm). The web inner `isLoading ? Skeleton…` branch sits inside that same not-loading body, so it is dead in both web and native; it is preserved verbatim (3 placeholder bars) to honour line coverage and structural fidelity. usePageTitle(t('API Keys')) drives the browser document.title, which has no React Native analogue, so the same translated string is surfaced as the on-screen accessibilityRole="header" page title instead (the user-visible manifestation of the page title).

DOM/web-UI swaps — no DOM, Recharts, Leaflet, framer-motion, lucide-react, or old web UI imports: GlassPanel -> native GlassPanel; Badge variant=danger 'Expired' -> an inline danger pill (dangerSurface/dangerBorder/danger); Button primary/secondary (sm/md, lucide Plus icon, loading spinner, disabled) -> a native Pressable TextButton preserving variant/disabled/loading (ActivityIndicator while loading); Button variant=ghost iconOnly (XCircle revoke / Trash2 delete) -> IconGhostButton Pressables carrying accessibilityLabel t('Revoke')/t('Delete') and warning/danger-toned glyphs (⊘ / ✕); CopyButton(secondary,iconOnly,withToast) -> CopyKeyButton, a secondary icon Pressable using the same native-safe navigator.clipboard strategy as the shared MaskedValue (reports unavailable on iOS/Android until a clipboard module is bundled) with the withToast confirmation reproduced inline by a ⧉ -> ✓ glyph swap and a 2s reset timer cleared on unmount; MaskedValue(token,copyable,auditOnReveal) -> the shared native MaskedValue parity component, props verbatim; Input -> a labelled TextInput (onChange e.target.value -> onChangeText); Select -> a labelled segmented radio pill group (the established FeedbackModal single-choice control) preserving the {value,label} options and value/onChange; Modal -> RN Modal (transparent fade) with backdrop + dialog via an inline ModalShell; ConfirmDialog(danger) -> an inline ModalShell confirm dialog preserving the {{name}} message and onConfirm/onCancel gating; EmptyState(Key icon) -> the shared native EmptyState preceded by a decorative SemanticIcon name="key"; StaggerContainer/StaggerItem -> a plain gapped View list; lucide Key row icon (bg-neon-cyan/5 text-neon-cyan) -> a boxed 'KY' glyph in accent/accentSoft; the decorative lucide Clock before 'Created' is dropped (purely ornamental, no data lost); cn('p-4', isExpired && 'opacity-50') -> padding + a static opacity:0.5 style. formatDate is inlined faithfully from @/lib/dateFormat (— fallback for nullish/NaN, toLocaleDateString year/short-month/day in the host locale/timezone). Tailwind text-[var(--text-*)] colours map to theme tokens (textPrimary/textMuted/textSecondary). Every web slot carries a testID (api-keys-page/-loading/-list/-empty, api-key-row-<id>, api-keys-create-button, api-key-create-modal/-generated/-name-input/-perm-option-<v>/-generate-button/-cancel-button/-done-button/-copy-button, api-key-delete-dialog/-confirm-delete-button/-cancel-delete-button, api-key-revoke-<id>/-delete-<id>/-permission-<perm>/-expired-badge).

Gates: `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint -- --quiet`, and `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` all pass. A colocated __tests__/APIKeysPageParity.test.tsx mocks the useAdmin hooks and asserts the loading, empty, and populated-list (name + permission label + revoke/delete actions) renders, plus that no raw web key prefix is leaked, with no open handles.
